description: CommandMate #3004: the plan states how many scope entries the issue DECLARED and how many the planner DERIVED, apart. Both numbers were already in the JSON (`scope_defaults` is the derived subset of `suspected_files`), but nothing a human reads showed them separately, so "can this be dispatched" was judged on the inflated total (Kewton/Musunest: 55 / 61 / 60 listed for 20 / 22 / 22 real files). The declared test `src/cart/__tests__/total.test.ts` counts as declared and is not re-derived; `.test` / `.spec` / `__tests__/total.ts` are the 3 derived. `scope.allow` itself is unchanged — L1 still derives all of them (ADR §15.2).
